newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate closes slightly up.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate closes slightly up.

text.p: Taiwan's overnight rate ended slightly higher on Thursday after the central bank's repeated issuances of negotiable certificates of deposits to mop up liquidity, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate finished at 6.350 percent against Wednesday's 6.338 close -- still far outside the central bank's 5.00-5.5 percent target zone -- with 30-day commercial paper down to 6.30 against 6.35.
The overnight rate had fallen for 10 straight sessions before Thursday's rise.
The central bank issued T$5 billion in one-month NCDs on Thursday at an average yield of 6.385 percent.
The government bond yields remained in a narrow-range consolidation. The 10-year 86/4 bond yield was traded at 6.0888 percent against 6.0890-0895 in earlier session.
